subject: HEXOS-5: PWA install to Chromebook/tablet/laptop, no flashing
description:
Installable, real icon, opens without browser chrome, runs on hardware already owned. Where most of the 'feels like an OS' payoff actually lands. Explicitly NOT doing Chromebook write-protect defeat or tablet flashing.
[2026-08-31 15:35] Shipped 2026-08-31 as a MANIFEST-ONLY PWA: no service worker. A /hex/-scoped worker outranks tenant-sw.js at '/' (longest scope wins) and would have silently stopped the TenantRouter+TenantShell injection that IS the white-label guarantee. A load-time guard cannot fix it: a navigation's controller is resolved before the document's scripts run. Chrome reports zero installability errors with no worker, verified against production. hex-sw.js kept inert for HEXOS-5b, where offline belongs in the single root worker. Gate: _tools/hexos/pwa.test.js, deploy.sh Gate 3.8.
